description:
The surah that opens with the edifying question regarding human awareness of the coming of a sure cataclysmic event it calls **The Enveloper**. It takes its name from "the enveloper" (al-ghāshiyah) mentioned in verse 1. The surah serves to warn the disbelievers, encourage the Prophet Muḥammad and the believers, and absolve him of responsibility for the disbelievers.
The surah is also known as: The Overpowering, The Overwhelmer, The Overwhelming, The Overwhelming Event, The Pall, The Whelming.

translations.1: Did you receive the account of the Enveloper?
translations.2: Some faces on that day will be humbled,
translations.4: they will enter a scorching fire,
translations.5: and made to drink from a boiling spring.
translations.6: They will have no food except cactus,
translations.7:
neither nourishing,
  nor availing against hunger.
translations.8: Some faces on that day will be joyous,
translations.11: wherein they will not hear any vain talk.
translations.12: In it there is a flowing spring
translations.13: and in it there are raised couches,
translations.15: and cushions laid out in an array,
translations.17:
Do they not observe<{["F", 1]}> the camel,
  [to see] how she has been created?
translations.18: and the sky, how it has been raised?
translations.19: and the mountains, how they have been set?
translations.20: and the earth, how it has been surfaced?
translations.22: and not a taskmaster over them—
translations.23: except him who turns back and disbelieves.
translations.24: Him Allah will punish with the greatest punishment.
translations.25: Indeed to Us will be their return.
translations.26: Then, indeed, their reckoning will lie with Us.
